`dedupe` is implemented in `seq.py`, but one of the two tests can't pass alongside your spec, so I've left it failing.

`test_keeps_order` passes. `test_letters` expects `dedupe(['b', 'a', 'b', 'c'])` to return `['a', 'b', 'c']`. Keeping each item's first appearance gives `['b', 'a', 'c']`. The two tests also rule out sorting, because `[3, 1, 3, 2]` must stay `[3, 1, 2]`. The only way to satisfy both would be a special case for that input, which I didn't want to add.

I think the expected value in `test_letters` is a typo and should be `['b', 'a', 'c']`. I haven't edited the test. If you confirm, I'll change it.
